Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 145 as introduced would reduce, by an undetermined amount, the business license tax receipts of municipalities that levy taxes based on gross receipts, by deducting federal, state, and local excise taxes paid by the business from the calculation of the municipal business license tax. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
